body_markdown:
### [AI decision flow step](https://www.windmill.dev/changelog/ai-decision-step)


AI


Flow editor


[v1.824.0](https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/tag/v1.824.0)


[Docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/flows/ai_decision)


A new AI decision step asks a decision model, TypeSafe's Jev or Cloudflare's Clef on Workers AI, typed questions about a state and returns calibrated answers instead of text. Route on the answers with a Branch to one that the editor builds from the questions, or give the step to an AI agent as a tool.


#### New features


- Choice, score and yes/no questions, answered with the choice and its probabilities, a score on a scale, or the probability of yes.
- Later steps read results.<step>.output.<question>.choice, .score or .noul.
- "Branch on this question" in a question card, or "Branch on <question>" beside the step on the graph, inserts a Branch to one with one branch per option.
- As an AI agent tool, the calling model supplies the state and receives only the answers.
- TypeSafe and Cloudflare resources serve decision steps only.
